definitions.explanation: A humble expression meaning to meet or see someone, used when referring to meeting someone of higher status.

examples.japanese: お{目|め}に{掛|か}かれて⟦{光栄|こうえい}→光栄：19436_kouei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's an honor to meet you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧お{目|め}に{掛|か}かった⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧
examples.english: The person I met the other day.

examples.japanese: ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧お{目|め}に{掛|か}かりたい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I would like to meet you again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{目|め}に{掛|か}かる⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しく→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦{存|ぞん}じます→存じる：05912_zonjiru⟧。
examples.english: I am very pleased to have been given the opportunity to meet the company president.
examples.notes: [Note: 存じます is humble form of 思います]

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧お{目|め}に{掛|か}かった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: The first time we met was at last year's conference reception, wasn't it?

notes:
お{目|め}に{掛|か}かる is a humble verb for meeting someone.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: お{目|め}に{掛|か}かる

REGISTER:
- Very formal/humble expression
- Used in business and formal situations
- Shows respect to the person you are meeting

RELATED WORDS:
- お{目|め}に{掛|か}かる: to meet (humble)
- ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet (neutral)
- ⟦お{会|あ}いする→お会いする：22190_oaisuru⟧: to meet (polite)
- ⟦{拝見|はいけん}する→拝見：02082_haiken⟧: to see (humble, for things)
